title: guianima
body:
Animated UI is a lightweight visual mod that makes Minecraft’s interface feel smoother and more modern.

It adds clean opening and closing animations to different GUI screens, including the inventory, the Tab player list, menus, and other interface panels. Instead of instantly appearing, UI windows can smoothly slide, fade, or scale into view.

The mod does not change gameplay — it only improves the look and feel of Minecraft’s interface.
